title: What does comprehensive evaluation actually give you?

xj_js: Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University 2026 Jiangsu comprehensive evaluation brochure
xj_gd: Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University 2026 Guangdong comprehensive evaluation brochure

lines.t: Two students are preparing for the gaokao. One of them also sits a [[university interview]].
So what does that interview actually give them?
This is [[comprehensive evaluation]]: the university adds its own assessment to the gaokao score.
Take XJTLU's 2026 rules for Jiangsu: the composite score is out of 100.
The gaokao, scaled to 100 points, counts for [[65 percent]]. The interview counts for [[35 percent]].
Student A scores 600 on the gaokao and 90 in the interview. Student B scores 615 and 70.
Scaling the gaokao from 750, A gets [[83.50]], and B gets [[77.80]].
Fifteen points behind on the gaokao, and the interview turns it around.
That's the first thing it adds: [[points you can earn by preparing]], beyond the gaokao.
You must still clear the [[special-category control line]], and a weak interview can pull you back.
The second thing is [[one more chance to be admitted]].
XJTLU says you can still apply in the regular undergraduate round.
CUHK-Shenzhen says it [[doesn't affect]] your later applications.
But move to another province, and the rules can change.
In Guangdong, it's 65 percent gaokao, 30 interview and [[5 academic tests]], with a [[May 20th]] deadline.
So always check [[which province and which year]] the rules are for.
It takes time, too: apply in April or May, and interview [[soon after the gaokao]].
The interview? The brochure says it assesses English, overall competence and ability, [[not subject knowledge]].
In practice, that means stating [[a view and a reason]] clearly in English.
Write only an opinion, and the feedback flags the missing reason. Add because, and check again.
So it adds [[one more assessment]] and [[one more admission chance]], at the cost of thresholds, time and preparation.
Before applying, check three things: your province, whether you'll clear the line, and whether you have time to prepare.
